REVIEW REQUEST — BACK MATTER TEMPLATE
=====================================

Copy this and place it at the back of your book, before the "about the
author" page. Keep it short and never ask for a specific star rating.

If you enjoyed [Book title], a quick review on Amazon, Goodreads, or
StoryGraph helps other readers find it. Your honest thoughts — in your
own words — mean more than any star rating.

Thank you for reading.

— [Author name]
[Website] | [Newsletter link]
